title: Neighbor, partial info: elderly woman 'confused', calls him by the wrong name, invented words

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Next door to me, 214 Hugo Street. The lady who lives there, Mrs. Okafor. I'm her neighbor, I just came over to bring her mail.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She seems confused. She called me Teddy, that's not my name, and she's saying words I've never heard, like she's making them up, but she talks like she thinks they make sense.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Is she awake and breathing okay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, she's sitting in her armchair, breathing fine, she just looks frustrated with me.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When did you last see her acting normally?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I saw her at the mailbox around eleven this morning and she waved and chatted with me, totally like herself.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Do you know how old she is or what medicines she takes?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Eighty-something? I really don't know her medicines. Her son would know but I don't have his number.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Stay with her if you can.
